articles.title: Congress Launches 'Quit Drugs, Unite India' Campaign With Marathon In Amritsar
articles.description: The Congress party launched its 'Quit Drugs, Unite India' campaign with an anti-drug marathon in Amritsar, Punjab. The event marked the beginning of the party's campaign against drug abuse, using the marathon to raise awareness about the issue and promote its anti-drug message.

articles.title: Karnataka brushes aside Tamil Nadu's Mekedatu objections, pursues Centre for clearances
articles.description: Karnataka Chief Minister DK Shivakumar reaffirmed the state's commitment to the Mekedatu reservoir project despite Tamil Nadu's objections. Shivakumar emphasized that the project must comply with the Supreme Court’s directives and welcomed discussions with Tamil Nadu. Home Minister Priyank Kharge supported the initiative, stating it would benefit both states. Farmers in Tamil Nadu protested, expressing concerns over potential water scarcity issues.

articles.title: At 91, her first passport came; by 96, Ohio grandmother had travelled all continents: How a 10-year travel journey healed her family estrangement
articles.description: At 96, Ohio grandmother Joy Ryan, known as Grandma Joy, has achieved an extraordinary travel milestone by visiting all seven continents with her grandson, Brad Ryan. After getting her first passport at 91, she travelled from seeing African elephants to Australian koalas. But their journey is about more than travel. It also helped the grandmother and grandson reconnect after 10 years of estrangement.

articles.title: Judge: Stop Censoring Anti-ICE Groups on Social Media
